# City of Brampton

> > Official municipal website for Brampton, Ontario, featuring tourism, business support, community events, and entrepreneur resources including the Brampton Entrepreneur Centre and Film Office.

The City of Brampton serves residents and visitors through comprehensive municipal services, cultural programming, and economic development initiatives. Key facilities include the Brampton Entrepreneur Centre with its Commercial Kitchen and Global Business Centre, the Brampton Film Office supporting the creative sector, and tourism development through BTDC (Brampton Tourism Development Corporation).

## Key Topics

- Brampton Entrepreneur Centre (BEC)
- Brampton Film Office
- Sport Tourism Strategy
- Brampton Tourism Development Corporation (BTDC)
- Ken Giles Citizen Awards
- Brampton Commercial Kitchen
- Summer Company Program
- Go Global initiative
- Foodpreneur Advantage Program
- Community events and festivals
- Event planning and permits
- Arts and culture programming
- Visitor guide and attractions
- Youth entrepreneurship
- Business support services

## Business and Entrepreneurship

- [Brampton Entrepreneur Centre](https://www.brampton.ca/en/Business/bec): BEC offering Commercial Kitchen, coworking & Global Business Centre
- [Brampton Entrepreneur Centre](https://www.brampton.ca/EN/Business/BEC): Business support hub with Commercial Kitchen & startup consultations
- [Summer Company Program for Young Entrepreneurs](https://www1.brampton.ca/EN/Business/BEC/youth): Ontario youth startup grants & mentorship via Brampton Entrepreneur Centre
- [Summer Company Program for Young Entrepreneurs](https://www1.brampton.ca/en/Business/bec/youth): Summer business program for Ontario students with funding & mentorship

## Tourism and Attractions

- [Experience Brampton](https://www.brampton.ca/EN/Arts-Culture-Tourism/Experience-Brampton): Main tourism hub for Brampton attractions, Film Office & sport tourism
- [Experience Brampton](https://www1.brampton.ca/EN/Arts-Culture-Tourism/Experience-Brampton): Tourism portal featuring visitor guide, attractions & Film Office services

## Festivals, Events and Community Recognition

- [Festivals and Events](https://www1.brampton.ca/EN/Arts-Culture-Tourism/Festivals-and-Events): Community festivals, events calendar & event planning resources
- [Festivals and Events](https://www.brampton.ca/EN/Arts-Culture-Tourism/Festivals-and-Events): Brampton festivals calendar and community event planning information
- [Brampton Citizen Awards](https://www1.brampton.ca/EN/Arts-Culture-Tourism/Festivals-and-Events/Citizen-Awards): Ken Giles awards recognizing volunteers, sports & arts achievements
- [Brampton Citizen Awards](https://www.brampton.ca/EN/Arts-Culture-Tourism/Festivals-and-Events/Citizen-Awards): Community recognition program honoring Brampton volunteers & achievers
- [Planning Your Event](https://www1.brampton.ca/EN/Arts-Culture-Tourism/Festivals-and-Events/Planning-Your-Event): Event permit guide with SEAT & Peel Police requirements for festivals
